subject: accountancy
chapter_title: Reconstitution of a Partnership Firm - Retirement/Death of a Partner

concepts.title: Amount Due to a Retiring Partner
concepts.definition: The outgoing partner's claim is built up from his capital and current balances, his slice of goodwill, reserves, revaluation gain and profit earned till exit, and cut down by drawings, accumulated losses and revaluation loss.
concepts.key_idea: Everything the firm owes him on the exit date goes into one claim, then it is settled in cash, as a loan, or in instalments.
question_patterns: what items make up the amount due to a retiring partner
ascertain the claim of a partner who is retiring from the firm

solution_steps.action: collect every credit
solution_steps.explain: capital balance, current account credit, goodwill slice, reserve share, revaluation gain, profit to the exit date, interest on capital, salary or commission due

solution_steps.action: collect every deduction
solution_steps.explain: current account debit, accumulated loss share, revaluation loss share, loss to the exit date, drawings and interest on drawings

solution_steps.action: net the claim and settle it
solution_steps.explain: the difference is the amount due, paid in full, transferred to a loan account, or cleared in instalments with interest

concepts.title: New Share of a Continuing Partner
concepts.definition: After an outgoing partner leaves, each continuing partner's fresh entitlement is his own old fraction plus whatever part of the leaver's slice he picks up.
concepts.key_idea: If the leaver's share is absorbed in the old proportion, the survivors' ratio stays exactly as before.

solution_steps.action: value the slice picked up from the leaver
solution_steps.explain: multiply the outgoing partner's fraction by the fraction of it that this partner takes

solution_steps.action: add the pickup to the old fraction
solution_steps.explain: the continuing partner's new share is old share plus acquired share

concepts.title: Gaining Share of a Continuing Partner
concepts.definition: The piece of the departing partner's share that one continuing partner actually picks up equals his fresh fraction less the fraction he held before.
concepts.key_idea: A minus figure would mean the partner gave up share, so he compensates instead of being compensated.

solution_steps.action: deduct the old fraction from the new fraction

concepts.title: Gaining Ratio
concepts.definition: Placing each continuing partner's gain side by side gives the gaining ratio, the proportion in which goodwill compensation is charged to them.
concepts.key_idea: The remaining partners who gain compensate the leaver for goodwill strictly in this ratio.

solution_steps.explain: each difference is that partner's gain

solution_steps.action: simplify the differences
solution_steps.explain: the reduced whole numbers form the gaining ratio

concepts.title: Retiring Partner's Share of Goodwill
concepts.definition: The leaver carried part of the firm's reputation, so his slice equals the valued goodwill times his old profit fraction, charged to the gainers in their gaining ratio.
concepts.key_idea: Goodwill earned with everyone's efforts is paid out to the one who exits.

concepts.title: Hidden Goodwill at Settlement
concepts.definition: If the leaver is paid a lump sum larger than his adjusted capital balance, the extra is treated as his goodwill slice even though no goodwill value was quoted.
concepts.key_idea: An over-payment in full settlement quietly reveals the value of goodwill.

solution_steps.action: compare the payment with the adjusted claim
solution_steps.explain: the settlement above the amount already due is the hidden goodwill

concepts.title: Revaluation Result on Retirement
concepts.definition: Assets and liabilities are restated when a partner leaves, and the net gain or loss from that exercise is shared by every partner, the leaver included, in the old ratio.
concepts.key_idea: The outgoing partner also shares revaluation effects, unlike at an admission.

solution_steps.action: net the restatements
solution_steps.explain: subtract total downward revisions from total upward revisions

solution_steps.action: share the net result in the old ratio
solution_steps.explain: each partner, including the leaver, takes his old fraction

concepts.title: Accumulated Profits and Reserves on Retirement
concepts.definition: Reserves and undistributed profits built up before the exit belong to everyone, so each partner including the leaver lifts out his old-ratio slice.
concepts.key_idea: Accumulated losses travel the same road, debited to all partners in the old ratio.

concepts.title: Profit Share up to the Exit Date (Time Basis)
concepts.definition: When a partner leaves mid-year, his profit slice for the elapsed months is estimated from last year's profit, scaled by the fraction of the year gone and his profit share.
concepts.key_idea: Last year's result stands in for the unfinished year, credited through a profit and loss suspense account.

solution_steps.action: scale the yearly profit to the elapsed period
solution_steps.explain: multiply last year's profit by the months elapsed over twelve

solution_steps.action: apply the partner's fraction
solution_steps.explain: his profit share of the interim result is the answer

compute_steps.action: substitute the given values into the formula

concepts.title: Profit Share up to Exit (Average Profits Basis)
concepts.definition: The interim profit can instead rest on the average of recent years: average first, then scale for the elapsed months, then apply the leaver's fraction.
concepts.key_idea: Averaging smooths out an unusual final year before splitting the interim slice.

concepts.title: Profit Share up to Exit (Sales Basis)
concepts.definition: If the deed ties profit to turnover, the interim profit is found by growing last year's profit in proportion to the sales of the elapsed period against the full year, then applying the leaver's fraction.
concepts.key_idea: Turnover during the unfinished period drives the estimated profit.

solution_steps.explain: his slice of the estimated interim profit is the answer

concepts.title: Interest on Capital up to the Exit Date
concepts.definition: The claim of a partner leaving between balance sheet dates includes interest on his capital for the elapsed months, at the agreed yearly rate.
concepts.key_idea: Interest accrues only for the part of the year the partner's money stayed in the firm.

concepts.title: Interest on a Retiring Partner's Loan
concepts.definition: When the unpaid claim is turned into a loan, interest is charged on whatever balance is still outstanding at the agreed yearly rate.
concepts.key_idea: Each year the instalment first covers the interest on what is still owed.

concepts.title: Capital Adjustment After Retirement
concepts.definition: If the survivors fix the new firm's total capital, each one's required capital is his new-ratio slice of that total, and the gap against his existing balance is withdrawn or brought in.
concepts.key_idea: Surplus capital is paid off and a shortfall is topped up, keeping capitals in step with the new ratio.

solution_steps.action: compare with the existing balance
solution_steps.explain: required less existing gives the adjustment; negative means cash is paid off
